name: Power Amplifier - Retaliation
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized power supply unit that can be attached to an ST to raise its load limit. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Retaliation capability.

61010.name: Power Boost III · Retaliation
61010.SpecificEffects:
ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power.
When Retaliating, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
